name: SideKiqq
tagline: Your chief of staff, on every device.
description: SideKiqq reads your email and calendar, tracks every commitment and open loop, tells you who to follow up with, and drafts replies it never sends without your approval.

waitlist.heading: Get early access
waitlist.body: SideKiqq is in private development. Leave your email and we'll write when there's a seat for you. One email, no newsletter.
waitlist.successMessage: You're on the list. We'll email you when there's a seat.
waitlist.errorMessage: That didn't go through. Check the address and try again, or email us instead.
waitlist.fallbackBody: The waitlist form isn't connected yet. Email us and we'll add you by hand.

footer.note: SideKiqq is in private development. Nothing on this site is a promise of availability or pricing.
